The Courtyard

A quiet stone courtyard at the center of it all.

Shared by all four suites, our interior courtyard is a small retreat of its own — natural stone paving, an old stone wall, and pots of roses and cypress trees. Step outside for your morning coffee, or simply sit and take in Metsovo's quiet.
